StatusLIVE EXECUTIVE DASHBOARD
PurposeFounder-level review for outgoing cash commitments, supplier deposits, freight and broker payments, duties, and other shipment-linked funding releases that must be governed before cash leaves the business, especially when contained-movement rules are active.
Source ruleUpdate the cash forecast and exposure outlook, capital allocation and release priority review, daily operations command center, shipment control tower, executable-check control board, executive scenario and contingency review, executive risk register, credit and release control board, strategic counterparty trust review, trust posture matrix, supplier capacity review, and linked shipment or deal records first, then refresh this review.
Founder usePrevent outgoing cash from moving faster than packet readiness, trust posture, liquidity timing, and live-gate proof.

WatchpointFounder interpretation
Outgoing cash disciplineOutgoing cash discipline should be as controlled as incoming cash discipline.
Shipment urgencyShipment urgency should not become permission for poorly timed payment release.
Healthy payment holdsA payment hold is healthy when it protects packet quality, cash quality, and release sequencing.
